## NYT::NFlow::TSourceReadDelayEstimatorSpec {#NYT_NFlow_TSourceReadDelayEstimatorSpec}

#|
|| **Parameter** | **Description** ||
|| `smoothing_period` | **Type**: [TDuration](./all_yson_structs#TDuration)
**Default value**: `1m`
Smoothing period for data-time input density, New, gate speed and system/event timestamp offset. ||
|| `max_observation_gap` | **Type**: [TDuration](./all_yson_structs#TDuration)
**Default value**: `5m`
Maximum interval between samples. A longer gap establishes a new baseline while retaining learned rates. ||
|| `max_density_age` | **Type**: [TDuration](./all_yson_structs#TDuration)
**Default value**: `5m`
Maximum time without new data-time progress before historical density becomes unknown. ||
|| `max_density_ratio` | **Type**: `double`
**Default value**: `4.0`
Maximum ratio between historical density and smoothed New before warning, checked separately for counts and bytes. Warnings do not suppress numerical estimates. ||
|| `max_event_offset_deviation` | **Type**: [TDuration](./all_yson_structs#TDuration)
**Default value**: `1m`
Maximum deviation of an observed batch system/event timestamp offset from its previous smoothed value before warning. ||
|| `warning_retention` | **Type**: [TDuration](./all_yson_structs#TDuration)
**Default value**: `5m`
Time to retain a timestamp-instability warning after the last excessive deviation. Absence of a warning does not prove accuracy for unread data. ||
